messages:
violet (partnerships): Quick sync — Asteria shipped two preprod Asteria-2 cards. We want a tight perf/W sweep and a short marketplace note if results look good. Can we agree a minimal matrix?
sam (hw-eng): Baseline firmware is ast2-fw-2026-03, kernel 6.1. We'll provide IPMI and power probe wiring. Recommend voltage steps: -6%, -3%, 0, +3%, +6%.
nora (perf): Minimal matrix suggestion: models=[redwood-base, redwood-opt-q4]; seq=[256,1024]; conc=[1,6]; power steps as Sam suggested; metrics=[tokens/s, J/token, P95]. Keep runs light: 4 steady runs per cell.
ellie (pm): Marketing asks: if we publish perf/W, need partner consent checkbox and legal review. Also want a 2‑sentence marketplace blurb draft ready post sign-off.
asteria-eng (Asteria Systems): Fine with consent loop. We can open bench access Tue-Wed nights. We'll upload firmware sha to the shared folder.
bench-bot: scheduled job ast2-sweep-1751239000 created; artifacts -> s3://redwood-partners/asteria/ast2-sweep/.
sam (hw-eng): I'll add BIOS knob toggles for turbo and llc flush. Will post a small script to flip knobs in infra/bench-scripts PR.
nora (perf): For collection use: ./bench_runner --model redwood-base --seq 1024 --conc 6 --dur 240 --power /sys/.../energy_uj --out ast2.csv. I will prepare an analysis notebook with perf/W scatter and P95 contours.
violet (partnerships): Ownership: Redwood = harness, analysis, copy; Asteria = hardware, firmware, legal consent. Timeline: finalize matrix today, runs Tue-Wed nights, quick pass Thu AM. Everyone ok?
asteria-eng (Asteria Systems): Confirmed. We'll add legal contact on thread and provision bench user by EOD Monday.
ellie (pm): Action items: Sam=PR+knob scripts, Asteria=bench creds+firmware sha, Nora=notebook template, Violet=marketplace blurb draft. I'll ping legal for consent template.
violet (partnerships): Thanks — posting a calendar slot now. Will update thread with any changes.
